digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge git delivery (push and merge recovery)
propositions: Bridge delivery abandons after a single transport fault (TLS, DNS, timeout) with zero retries, leaving converged commits unpushed and silently lost.
The push classifier in push.py treats all non-fast-forward failures identically: policy declines (terminal) and transport faults (should be retriable) both raise on first failure with no retry logic.
Recovery merge operations fail with merge-recovery-blocked when on-demand promisor fetches hit transient network faults during blob:none partial clone operations.
The existing non-fast-forward retry loop has no backoff between attempts and no bounded transport-specific retry budget separate from the 5-attempt non-FF budget.

Transport-retriable faults (certificate verification, connection reset, timeout, promisor fetch failure) must be distinguished from permanent policy declines using subtractive classification to avoid infinite retry loops.
